en: Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned town square in front of several historic European buildings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. A church or town-hall tower with a clock and weather vane rises at the right. In the middle of the square stands an ornate multi‑globe streetlamp and a circular flowerbed. People, including children, are walking and gathering in small groups. Signs on the right-hand building read like German commercial or municipal inscriptions.
